welcome.title: Welcome to Questline
welcome.body: Real tasks become small quests. Start in two taps, get a reward right away. Days off never count against you.
welcome.point_steps: Big tasks split into tiny steps
welcome.point_start: A focus timer that starts in two taps
welcome.point_rewards: XP, gold and a cozy home that grows with you

adventurer.title: Create your adventurer
adventurer.body: This is you on the quest. You can change everything later at Home.
adventurer.name: Name (optional)

quest.title: Add your first quest
quest.body: Something small you could start today. Just a title is enough.
quest.label: Quest title
quest.placeholder: For example: reply to one email

session.title: Try just 5 minutes
session.body: Starting is the hardest part, so let's make it tiny. A 5-minute focus timer begins on “{{quest}}”. Stopping early is always fine.
session.body_none: Whenever you're ready, add a quest on Today and tap Start. Five minutes is a great first try.
